name: DianSheng Galaxy Mirror 3x3 (Magnetic + Ball-Core, Electroplated)
description: The DianSheng Galaxy Mirror 3x3 follows the 5x5 and 4x4 versions in DianSheng's lineup. With smooth turning out of the box and a medium magnetic feel, this puzzle is a great way to complete your collection or get into speedsolving Mirror Cube. This version also has a magnetic core and an electroplated finish for enhanced stability and a true mirrored look.
